license: GEOROC data are provided under the DIGIS/GEOROC data policy. Users must cite GEOROC and the original publications for any analysis used.
method: Per-group distributions (n, p10/p25/p50/p75/p90) of major oxides. Rocks are grouped by GEOROC's own precompiled file name; minerals by the MINERAL column. Rows filtered to whole-rock or glass material (rocks), a 97-103 wt% total counting iron once and including reported LOI, H2O and CO2 (minerals that lack measured water or CO2 use a mineral-specific window, e.g. 52-60 wt% for calcite), a stoichiometric check of mineral rows against their label, and at least 6 reported oxides for rocks (one is enough for a mineral such as quartz).
parser: Streaming RFC 4180 reader; GEOROC files contain quoted fields with embedded newlines and a trailing bibliography block, both of which defeat line-based parsing.
